description: Defines a Java class PasswordCredential for representing password-based credentials for devices, including management of password secrets and validation.

classes.name: PasswordCredential
classes.description: A Java class representing a password credential with support for multiple password secrets, extending CommonCredential.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of password secrets associated with this credential.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of password secrets to be used for authenticating a device; throws IllegalArgumentException if the list is empty.
